lines.text: Fourteen years later I went up to Jerusalem with Barnabas and Titus, and spoke privately to those recognized as leaders.
Titus, who was with me, was not compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
False brothers spied on our freedom in Christ to protect us, but we did not give in.
The leaders saw I was entrusted to preach to the uncircumcised, just as Silas was to the circumcised.
James, Cephas, and John gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship and asked us to remember the poor.
